title: finding(components): object `params` on spec action entries (`element:button` inline, `action:group`, `action:menu`, `page:header`) is still forwarded as values — non-api residual of objectui#10289
body:
Filed by the `domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat, session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S`. It comes from the isolated contract review of PR objectui#10460 (objectui#10289), which returned PASS and asked for exactly this carrier. ⛔ Not graded: the priority belongs to triage.

## Fact, at PR objectui#10460 head `c3aff649a`

Ruling A on objectui#10289 (batch #224 item 4) made `params` the `ActionParam[]` inputs list only, with values moving to `properties.params`. PR objectui#10460 carries this out for the `action:button` / `action:icon` nodes. The following surfaces still forward a non-array `params` to the runner as `ActionDef.params` values:

| surface | site |
|:--|:--|
| `element:button` inline `action` | `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx:243-245` |
| `action:group` items | `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-group.tsx:270` |
| `action:menu` items | `packages/components/src/renderers/action/action-menu.tsx:258` |
| `page:header` `dispatchHeaderAction` | `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx:1808-1814` |
| app-shell | `MetadataTypeActions.tsx:138` |

These are spec action entries (`ActionSchema` / `InlineActionSchema`), and the spec refuses an object `params` at the authoring door. Two cases:
- **`type: 'api'`**: the objectstack#5777 window keeps the runner reading an object `params` as the payload, with a dev warning, until 18.
- **Every other type** (for example `navigate_edit` on an `element:button` inline action): an unvalidated object `params` still arrives as values. No window covers this.

## Direction

This is the tail of ruling A, not a new decision. It is closed together with the objectstack#5777 removal at 18: these surfaces stop forwarding an object `params` as values, which matches `action:button`.

Whether the non-api types move earlier, before 18, is a sequencing question for the PM or triage. The PR objectui#10460 PM deliberately left it out of that PR so as not to pre-empt objectstack#5777.

Seam: `spec:ActionSchema.params (ActionParam[] only)` → `renderer:element:button / action:group / action:menu / page:header` non-array forward
Dedupe words: `object params inline action forwarded` · `action:group params object` · `10289 residual` · `5777 removal params`
